title: US Click-to-Cancel, Subscription & ARL Compliance Auditor Input
description: Audit DTC e-commerce stores and B2B/B2C SaaS apps via fast zero-browser HTTP for US Click-to-Cancel & Auto-Renewal laws (California AB 2863, New York GBL § 527-a & NYC Oct 2026 Rule, Colorado SB 25-145 B2B SaaS, Federal ROSCA, and California SB 478 drip fees).

urls.title: Target Store or SaaS URLs / Bare Domains
urls.description: List of DTC store or SaaS URLs or bare domains to audit (supports full URLs like "https://shop.example.com", bare domains like "app.example.com", or RequestList objects like [{"url": "https://shop.example.com"}]).

url.title: Single URL or Domain (Optional Shorthand)
url.description: Optional single store or SaaS URL/domain convenience field for REST webhooks, Clay HTTP columns, or MCP calls.

datasetId.title: Upstream Apify Dataset ID (Optional Chaining)
datasetId.description: Optional Apify Dataset ID (e.g. from Shopify Store Scraper, Google Maps Scraper, or SaaS Directory Scraper) to auto-import URLs and deduplicate with urls.

datasetUrlField.title: Dataset URL Field Override (Optional)
datasetUrlField.description: Optional column name to extract URLs from datasetId items. When omitted, auto-detects website, url, domain, shopUrl, storeUrl, appUrl, or pricingUrl.

maxLegalPagesPerDomain.title: Max Internal Pricing/Terms/Cancel Subpages per Site
maxLegalPagesPerDomain.description: Maximum number of discovered same-origin internal pages (/cancel, /pricing, /plans, /subscribe, /membership, /terms, /billing, /faq) fetched per site in addition to the homepage (0-5).

includeRemediationPack.title: Generate US ARL Consent + 1-Click Cancel HTML/JS Pack
includeRemediationPack.description: Generates ready-to-paste CA AB 2863 / CO SB 25-145 Unchecked Express Auto-Renewal Consent Box + 1-Click Online Cancellation Modal HTML/JS snippets when compliance findings exist (+$0.01/site).

checkClickToCancel.title: Check Online Click-to-Cancel & Survey/Support Obstructions
checkClickToCancel.description: Checks for online same-medium Click-to-Cancel links/portals vs. call-only/email-only/chat-only cancellation traps and NYC Oct 2026 mandatory exit-survey gates (CA AB 2863, NY GBL § 527-a, CO SB 25-145, ROSCA).

checkAffirmativeConsent.title: Check Affirmative Auto-Renewal Consent & Trial Disclosures
checkAffirmativeConsent.description: Inspects subscription and trial flows for pre-checked recurring checkboxes (<input type=checkbox checked>), continuous auto-renewal disclosures, and post-trial conversion price/deadline terms.

checkDripFees.title: Check Drip Pricing / Mandatory Junk Fees (CA SB 478)
checkDripFees.description: Scans pricing, checkout, and terms text for mandatory service, processing, convenience, or platform fees disclosed outside upfront prices (Cal. Civ. Code § 1770(a)(29)).

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Checks domain /robots.txt rules before scanning and skips disallowed paths.

maxUrls.title: Max Sites Safety Cap
maxUrls.description: Hard ceiling on the total number of sites audited in a single run to prevent accidental budget overruns.

domainDelayMs.title: Per-Domain Polite Delay (ms)
domainDelayMs.description: Minimum polite delay in milliseconds between consecutive HTTP requests to the same hostname.

requestTimeoutMs.title: HTTP Request Timeout (ms)
requestTimeoutMs.description: Strict timeout per HTTP request in milliseconds (default 12000ms).
